# Author Policies Checklist: Repository & Branch Author Policies

**Purpose**: Review completeness, clarity, consistency, and testability of scope-aware author-policy requirements.  
**Created**: 2026-09-30  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are identity and uniqueness requirements defined separately for Group and Repository/Branch policies? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002–003]
- [ ] CHK002 - Does the specification define whether a repository must be directly selected before it can receive a branch policy, distinct from inclusion through a selected Group? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001, FR-005]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are retained policies that leave scope clearly distinguished from active policies in both persistence and user-facing requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, FR-022]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are all legacy fallback states and the explicit per-configuration transition described without deleting legacy data? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, FR-019]

## Requirement Clarity and Consistency

- [ ] CHK005 - Is the resolution defined when multiple selected Group policies overlap the same dynamically included repository? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006–008]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are repository/branch precedence, Group branch coverage, missing policy, and explicit empty-policy semantics stated consistently in requirements and edge cases? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006–008]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is the unavailable-branch failure scope clear about which stored branch references are checked when the existing pipeline processes a repository? [Clarity, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is it clear whether non-default branch policies configure authorization only or also select branches for mining? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003, FR-013–014]
- [ ] CHK009 - Are exact identity keys based on GitLab instance plus stable Group/Project ID, with name/path limited to descriptive metadata? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002–005]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the one-way legacy-to-scope-aware transition sufficiently explained, including what happens to unmatched future executions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, FR-019]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK011 - Are policy outcomes defined for repository-only, Group-only, overlapping Group/repository, absent policy, explicit empty policy, and legacy fallback cases? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007–008]
- [ ] CHK012 - Are scope removal and later re-selection of the same stable identity covered without policy reassignment? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are inaccessible/deleted branches distinguished from an empty branch list and from a GitLab discovery failure? [Coverage, Spec §FR-023, FR-026]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are GitLab instance changes, inaccessible selected entities, provider failures, and credential absence addressed with safe outcomes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004–005, FR-020, FR-023]
- [ ] CHK015 - Does the spec explain how policy and scope edits interact with optimistic concurrency and stale revisions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021]

## Historical Integrity, Security, and Acceptance Quality

- [ ] CHK016 - Are snapshot contents sufficient to explain authorization historically while explicitly excluding credentials and live re-evaluation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016–017]
- [ ] CHK017 - Are checkpoint preservation and prohibition on retroactive reclassification unambiguous after a policy change? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK018 - Are Finding branch-context requirements tied to historical execution data rather than current GitLab state? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015–017]
- [ ] CHK019 - Can each Success Criterion be objectively evaluated without relying on fabricated data or unsupported Finding types? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–010]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are the requirements for keyboard navigation, accessible validation, loading, retry, and responsive policy editing complete for both Group and Repository workflows? [Coverage, Spec §FR-022–024]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave reviewer-owned markers unchanged unless the reviewer evaluates them.
- This checklist evaluates requirements quality, not implementation behavior.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- [ ] CHK021 - Are no-new-rule, no-checkpoint-reset, no-AI, and no-triage boundaries consistent across scope, exclusions, and success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018, FR-025]
